rows.response_text: To prepare fresh sunflower seeds for consumption, first, wrap a piece of cheesecloth around the head of the sunflower and secure it with string to protect the seeds from birds. Then, cut the stem 12 inches below the cheesecloth-wrapped head once the petals have wilted and half of them have fallen off. Tie a second piece of string around the bottom of the stem and hang the sunflower upside down in a cool, dry place until the seeds dry completely and fall into the cheesecloth. Finally, spread the dried seeds out on a fine-mesh screen placed on a sheet pan in a cool, dry place away from drafts or direct sunlight.
